items.name: video-kit
items.title: Video Kit
items.description: The Better Design video kit: the theme every video component paints from, shared easing and springs, colour helpers that read any CSS colour, oklch() included, and mix in OKLab, a caret, a text field, phone and laptop frames drawn from real hardware measurements, and sound: cues, a mixer and a SoundTrack that plays the CC0 Better Design sound pack. The install command for any component brings it in.

items.name: stat-count
items.title: Stat Count
items.description: Stat count animation: one sourced number climbs to its value while a hairline under it fills, then the label settles in. The proof beat of a launch film.

items.name: bar-rise
items.title: Bar Rise
items.description: Bar chart animation: bars grow from the baseline one after another while each value counts up above it, and the last bar lands in the primary colour.

items.name: line-trace
items.title: Line Trace
items.description: Line chart animation: a smooth line draws itself left to right over a soft area fill, a dot rides its leading edge, and the final value is called out where it ends.

items.name: ring-meter
items.title: Ring Meter
items.description: Progress ring animation: a ring sweeps round to a percentage while the number counts up in its centre, then a caption settles under it.

items.name: digit-roll
items.title: Digit Roll
items.description: Odometer number animation: each digit rolls vertically into place, the ones column first and each column to its left a beat later, then a label settles under the figure.

items.name: comment-pile
items.title: Comment Pile
items.description: Comment section animation: comment cards land under a launch post faster and faster until they fill the frame, then one comment lifts out of the dimmed pile.

items.name: supporter-grid
items.title: Supporter Grid
items.description: Supporter wall animation: a grid of initials avatars switches on in a wave from the centre while the supporter count climbs, then a thank-you line closes the shot.

items.name: message-bubbles
items.title: Message Bubbles
items.description: Text message animation: a phone thread shares a link to a product video and the replies pop in after typing dots, on alternating sides.

items.name: tool-calls
items.title: Tool Calls
items.description: AI agent tool call animation: tool-call chips arrive one by one and resolve from a spinner to a check, then the agent's short answer writes itself word by word.

items.name: file-attach
items.title: File Attach
items.description: File upload to AI prompt animation: file thumbnails slide in, drop into a prompt composer as attachment chips, then the prompt types itself and the send button presses.

items.name: device-drop
items.title: Device Drop
items.description: Phone mockup animation: a headline settles in on the left while a phone is set down on the right with weight, a small overshoot and a soft contact shadow. The screen shows your screenshot or a placeholder app.

items.name: button-dive
items.title: Button Dive
items.description: Button zoom animation: the camera pushes into a primary button until its fill covers the frame, then the fill opens into the app it leads to.

items.name: screenshot-wall
items.title: Screenshot Wall
items.description: Screenshot wall animation: a tilted wall of product screens drifts slowly on the diagonal, then one screen lifts forward to the centre with a caption.

items.name: compare-split
items.title: Compare Split
items.description: Before and after animation: the old screen and the new one share the frame, split by a handle that stops halfway so both read, then hands the whole frame to the new screen.

items.name: skeleton-build
items.title: Skeleton Build
items.description: UI generation animation: a product screen builds itself. Loading blocks grow in reading order with a soft shimmer, then each one resolves in place into the real interface, with bars rising and figures counting up.

items.name: picker-spin
items.title: Picker Spin
items.description: Picker wheel animation: an iOS-style wheel is flicked, slows down and lands on one row, which turns the primary colour and confirms with a check.

items.name: version-stamp
items.title: Version Stamp
items.description: Release end card animation: the product name types in, a large version number stamps down with a short shake, and a dated line settles under it.

items.name: strike-swap
items.title: Strike Swap
items.description: Strikethrough text animation: one phrase in a sentence is struck out with a hand-drawn line and fades back, then a better phrase writes in after it.

items.name: transition-iris
items.title: Iris Transition
items.description: Iris transition: the next scene opens through a circle that grows from any point you choose. Exports iris() for TransitionSeries and a demo.

items.name: transition-zoom-through
items.title: Zoom Through Transition
items.description: Zoom through transition: the outgoing scene scales up and blurs past the lens while the next scene settles in from slightly large. Exports zoomThrough() for TransitionSeries and a demo.

items.name: transition-whip-pan
items.title: Whip Pan Transition
items.description: Whip pan transition: a fast sideways camera move where both scenes travel together under horizontal motion blur. Exports whipPan() for TransitionSeries and a demo.

items.name: transition-blur-dissolve
items.title: Blur Dissolve Transition
items.description: Blur dissolve transition: a cross-dissolve where both scenes go soft at the midpoint. Exports blurDissolve() for TransitionSeries and a demo.

items.name: transition-grid-wipe
items.title: Grid Wipe Transition
items.description: Grid wipe transition: the next scene appears through a grid of tiles that grow in a diagonal wave. Exports gridWipe() for TransitionSeries and a demo.

items.name: gradient-field
items.title: Gradient Field
items.description: Gradient background animation: soft blobs in tones of the primary colour drift slowly over the page and loop without a seam. Children draw on top.

items.name: dot-grid
items.title: Dot Grid
items.description: Dot grid background animation: an even field of dots drifts diagonally while a wave of primary light travels across it, looping without a seam. Children draw on top.

items.name: film-grain
items.title: Film Grain
items.description: Film grain overlay: fine animated grain and a soft vignette laid over your footage, deterministic on every render. Children draw underneath.

items.name: light-sweep
items.title: Light Sweep
items.description: Light sweep background animation: a soft diagonal band of light crosses the surface every few seconds, like a reflection on glass. Children draw underneath.

items.name: answer-select
items.title: Answer Select
items.description: Text selection animation: a question sits in a pill, the answer writes itself word by word, then one phrase is selected and a small toolbar opens under it.

items.name: answer-reply
items.title: Answer Reply
items.description: Chat reply animation: a close shot of the send button being pressed, then a cut to the wide shot where the answer streams in line by line while the camera eases back.

items.name: prompt-compose
items.title: Prompt Compose
items.description: Prompt typing animation: a composer card grows out of a thin line, the prompt types itself, and a pointer glides in to press send, which turns into a check.

items.name: assistant-home
items.title: Assistant Home
items.description: Assistant start screen animation: a greeting, an input and suggestion chips appear, then the chips fall away and the camera pushes into the input as the prompt types.

items.name: search-bar
items.title: Search Bar
items.description: Search animation: a query types into a wide search field, the field rises, and a results list drops in with the matching words marked and the first result focused.

items.name: status-pill
items.title: Status Pill
items.description: Status badge animation: a centred sentence holds an inline pill that rolls through its states, each with its own icon and colour, until the last one lands.

items.name: phone-mockup
items.title: Phone Mockup
items.description: Phone mockup animation: a phone tilts up into view and settles at an angle beside a caption, showing your screenshot, your screen recording or a placeholder app.

items.name: laptop-mockup
items.title: Laptop Mockup
items.description: Laptop mockup animation: a closed laptop opens its lid, the screen lights up, then the camera pushes in until the screen fills the frame. Takes an image or a video for the screen.

items.name: terminal-session
items.title: Terminal Session
items.description: Terminal animation: commands type after a prompt, output prints in short bursts, a spinner runs and a green success line lands. Every line is a prop.

items.name: recording-shot
items.title: Recording Shot
items.description: Screen recording animation: turns a raw screen capture into a finished shot. It keeps the region you name, frames it to fill or show whole, starts at any frame and moves a camera to any point without showing an empty edge.

items.name: cursor-path
items.title: Cursor Path
items.description: Cursor animation: a pointer walks a path of waypoints over your screen and clicks where you mark it, with a press and a ripple. The placeholder card answers each click.

items.name: screenshot-capture
items.title: Screenshot Capture
items.description: Screenshot capture animation: a browser window is captured while a toast counts to 100 percent, then the window drops away and the toast confirms the copy with a check.

items.name: headline-reveal
items.title: Headline Reveal
items.description: Headline reveal animation: a headline arrives four ways. Words rise out of a soft blur, letters land as the tracking settles, words build the line from the centre, or words fly in out of order and lock into place.

items.name: word-mark
items.title: Word Mark
items.description: Highlight text animation: a sentence settles, then one phrase in it is marked by hand with a highlighter sweep, a drawn underline, a loose ring or a tight box.

items.name: type-line
items.title: Type Line
items.description: Typewriter text animation: a line types out behind a blinking caret, then its ending is deleted and retyped, selected and typed over, or morphed letter by letter into new words.

items.name: word-rotate
items.title: Word Rotate
items.description: Rotating word animation: a sentence with one slot that cycles through words by sliding, flipping, spinning a reel or ticking a checkbox as each word lands. The slot resizes to each word.

items.name: letter-wave
items.title: Letter Wave
items.description: Letter wave animation: a title rides in letter by letter on a travelling wave with a small bounce, its lead words first and scaling toward the viewer, then a soft ripple runs along it.

items.name: glyph-decode
items.title: Glyph Decode
items.description: Text decode animation: a line resolves out of scrambled glyphs from left to right, each letter flashing the primary colour before it settles to ink, and a product name lands underneath.

items.name: title-cards
items.title: Title Cards
items.description: Title card animation: full-frame statements cut hard from one beat to the next, each held long enough to read. The key word on the last card lands in the primary colour.

items.name: launch-title
items.title: Launch Title
items.description: Launch title animation: a small eyebrow line, a cut to the product name assembling large letter by letter, then a cut to the tagline as a primary band sweeps across one word.

items.name: captions
items.title: Captions
items.description: Burned-in captions animation: word-timed captions for vertical and landscape videos, either popping on a few words at a time or filling a full line word by word. They sit in the safe area on a soft backdrop, so they read over any picture.

items.name: shape-story
items.title: Shape Story
items.description: Kinetic sentence animation: a sentence told one beat at a time, centred, while soft shapes in primary tints burst from the newest word, split in two and drift into place behind it.

items.name: glow-frame
items.title: Glow Frame
items.description: Glowing border animation: a soft glow around the whole frame pulses while something is working, then calms to a steady primary line. Any content can sit inside.

items.name: logo-cloud
items.title: Logo Cloud
items.description: Logo cloud animation: a field of integration tiles drifts slowly behind a centred headline while the camera pulls back. Logos are names drawn as wordmark chips, or images when you pass image paths.

items.name: logo-reveal
items.title: Logo Reveal
items.description: Logo reveal animation: a set of pictures collapses into the product mark and the name sets beside it. Choose an orbit, a fast flicker or a flicked stack.

items.name: wordmark-build
items.title: Wordmark Build
items.description: Wordmark animation: solid blocks slide in and stack into a line, then resolve letter by letter into the brand name, with one accent block left as the full stop.

items.name: end-card
items.title: End Card
items.description: End card animation: the wordmark set huge across the frame, a hard cut to a close-up of part of it, then a calm end card with a call to action and a web address.

items.name: launch-hero
items.title: Launch Hero
items.description: Launch hero animation: two product cards slide in from opposite sides into an overlapping pair while the launch headline and subline settle above them.

items.name: card-carousel
items.title: Card Carousel
items.description: Card carousel animation: a rail of cards on a tilted plane is flicked sideways, coasts on its momentum and settles with one card centred and lifted.

items.name: photo-orbit
items.title: Photo Orbit
items.description: Photo gallery intro: pictures spiral in from the edges on one slow orbit around a title, smaller and dimmer as they reach the centre.

items.name: moodboard
items.title: Moodboard
items.description: Moodboard animation: a headline with one inline picture slot that swaps on the beat, then the camera flies into the last picture until it fills the frame.

items.name: photo-reel
items.title: Photo Reel
items.description: Photo reel animation: pictures cut fast between an opening and a closing caption, the last one zooming, then the frame closes into a collage.

items.name: team-channel
items.title: Team Channel
items.description: Team chat animation: a work channel fills itself in, typing dots before each message, and a reaction lands on the last one.

items.name: access-grant
items.title: Access Grant
items.description: Access granted animation: a pointer clicks a call to action and team member cards switch from pending to granted one after another.

items.name: film-product-launch
items.title: Product Launch Film
items.description: Product launch video template: a three-line hook, the name building into a wordmark, the product on a phone, two features, one sourced number and an end card, about 31 seconds.

items.name: film-changelog
items.title: Changelog Film
items.description: Changelog video template: the version stamps down, three changes play in turn (a screen recording, a marked sentence, a struck and replaced phrase), then the end card, about 20 seconds.

items.name: film-onboarding
items.title: Onboarding Film
items.description: Onboarding video template: a welcome headline, three steps (a pointer working through settings, a screen recording, rotating words), a ring that fills when setup is done, then the end card, about 30 seconds.

items.name: film-app-store-preview
items.title: App Store Preview Film
items.description: App Store preview video template, vertical: a title on a wave, the app on a phone, a plan picker that lands, a shared message thread, then the logo reveal, about 20 seconds at 1080 by 1920, the App Store size for 16:9 iPhones.

items.name: film-launch-day
items.title: Launch Day Film
items.description: Launch day video template for Product Hunt or Hacker News: title cards, a dive into the product, a prompt composing itself, the people who backed the launch and an end card that asks for support, about 20 seconds.

items.name: sound-breakdown
items.title: Sound Breakdown
items.description: Sound design breakdown video: a film plays above one lane per sound layer, each pass adds layers with their waveforms and labels, a playhead lights each cue as it sounds, and the last pass plays the full mix with music.

items.name: film-short-demo
items.title: Short Demo Film
items.description: Short product demo video with full sound design: a prompt types and sends, an agent runs its tools, the screen builds itself and the name lands, about 15 seconds, every cue mixed over a music bed.

items.name: film-short-demo-breakdown
items.title: Short Demo Sound Breakdown
items.description: Sound breakdown of the short demo film: four passes, keys and clicks, then pops, then whooshes and hits, then the full mix with music, each layer drawn as a labelled waveform lane.
